in_marathi.name: Dhayan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dhayan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhyaana’, which means 'meditation' or 'contemplation'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu spiritual traditions and is considered auspicious for those who seek inner peace and wisdom. It is believed that individuals named Dhayan have a strong connection to their spiritual self and are deeply introspective.
